title: Prebuild-snapshot compatibility fingerprints, invalidation rules, and warm-start downgrade truth for claimed M5 warm-start paths

key_invalidation_rules.effect: A source-tree drift rejects the snapshot for a cold build.
key_invalidation_rules.rationale: A snapshot built from a different source tree would serve stale tools and indexes as current truth, so it is rebuilt cold.

key_invalidation_rules.effect: A capsule-hash drift rejects the snapshot for a cold build.
key_invalidation_rules.rationale: A snapshot built from a different capsule definition is for a different environment, so it is rebuilt cold rather than reused.

key_invalidation_rules.effect: A platform / architecture drift invalidates and evicts the snapshot.
key_invalidation_rules.rationale: A snapshot built for a different platform is binary-incompatible and cannot be partially reused; it is invalidated.

key_invalidation_rules.effect: A policy-epoch drift invalidates and evicts the snapshot.
key_invalidation_rules.rationale: A snapshot built under an older policy epoch may carry capabilities the current policy disallows, so it is invalidated rather than trusted.

key_invalidation_rules.effect: An extension-lock drift narrows reuse to a partial warm start; the extension layer is rebuilt.
key_invalidation_rules.rationale: An extension-lock drift affects only the extension layer, so the unaffected base, toolchain, and dependency layers stay warm.

key_invalidation_rules.effect: A toolchain drift narrows reuse to a partial warm start; the toolchain layer is rebuilt.
key_invalidation_rules.rationale: A critical toolchain drift affects only the toolchain layer, so the unaffected layers stay warm while the toolchain is rebuilt.

artifact_invalidation_rules.effect: Losing a non-critical artifact narrows reuse to a partial warm start; the lost layer is rebuilt.
artifact_invalidation_rules.rationale: A lost dependency, extension, or index layer can be rebuilt over the intact base and toolchain, so the start stays partially warm.

artifact_invalidation_rules.effect: Losing a critical artifact rejects the snapshot for a cold build.
artifact_invalidation_rules.rationale: A lost base image or toolchain layer cannot be rebuilt over, so the snapshot is rebuilt cold rather than served partially.

drills.title: Source-tree drift rejects the snapshot for a cold build

steps.narration: A source-tree edit is introduced under the pinned snapshot while it still loads warm.
The recorded fingerprint is compared key-by-key against current truth.
The engine narrows reuse to cold; the snapshot is not served as current truth.
The affected layer is rebuilt and re-fingerprinted against current truth.
The recorded fingerprint matches current truth again; reuse returns to warm.
The recovered outcome matches the engine for a fully current snapshot.

drills.notes: Source-tree drift rejects warm reuse so a stale tree's tools and indexes are never served as current truth.

invariants: A prebuild snapshot is reused only when every fingerprint key — source-tree identity, capsule hash, platform/arch, policy epoch, extension lock, and critical toolchain digests — matches current truth and its critical artifacts are intact.

Drift class decides the floor: platform and policy drift invalidate the snapshot, source-tree and capsule drift force a cold build, and extension-lock and toolchain drift narrow to a partial warm start; the coldest contribution always wins.
Prebuild speed is never proof of compatibility: a fast-loading snapshot that no longer matches the source, policy, or platform is rejected or downgraded rather than served as current truth.

Every decision is metadata-first and self-explaining, so users and support tooling can distinguish a warm, partially warm, cold, or invalidated start and read the exact key or artifact that forced it.
A downgraded start narrows or disables the actions whose backing layer is being rebuilt instead of presenting stale tools or indexes as current truth.
The outcome maps onto the same governance warm-start posture the environment-capsule lane reads, so the prebuild lane narrows in lockstep instead of forking a parallel warm-start model.
